items: The reliance on synthetic data augmentation (Gaussian noise around both inputs and outputs) risks biasing the model, violating compositional constraints (simplex), and inflating apparent data volume without adding independent information.
Uncertainty estimation for the ANN (σ̂ used in the acquisition function) is not sufficiently specified; without calibrated uncertainty, active learning selection can be suboptimal.
The GA crosslinker appears treated as a binary feature (“+”/“−”), limiting the model’s ability to capture effects of crosslinker concentration—a potentially important degree of freedom.
Electrical characterization uses a two-electrode method over a fixed gap; contact resistance and geometry effects could confound true conductivity trends.

The grading-based SVM reports high overall accuracy, but class imbalance and per-class metrics (e.g., precision/recall, F1 for A vs. B/C) are not reported; calibration (e.g., Platt scaling) of SVM probabilities is not discussed despite use of probability thresholds.
Mechanical testing details (strain rate, sample geometry, anisotropy from freeze-drying) and long-term cycling/fatigue tests are not reported despite the wearable application.

Microstructural quantification (porosity/density by gravimetry, tomography; network morphology by SEM) is not systematically linked to mechanical/electrical outcomes, limiting mechanistic interpretability.
The use of mean relative error for log(R0) is unconventional and may obscure error magnitudes; additional metrics (R2, RMSE, calibration curves) would help.
Domain of applicability and extrapolation behavior of the ANN are not quantified; this is central for safe inverse design recommendations.
There is limited benchmarking against alternative small-data regressors with calibrated uncertainty (e.g., Gaussian Processes, ensembles) or Bayesian optimization for multi-objective inverse design.

Comparison to recent self-driving/agentic AI platforms and inverse-design techniques for porous media (e.g., property-conditional VAE, agentic toolchains) is not fully elaborated, and electromechanical stability comparisons to strain-invariant conductive aerogels (e.g., PEDOT:PSS frameworks with nanoscale encapsulation) are absent.
